claims.excerpt: NIST’s AI Risk Management Framework and Its Generative AI Profile
claims.claim: NIST’s AI Risk Management Framework is associated with a generative AI profile.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: NIST released AI RMF 1.0 in January 2023. It was designed for voluntary use and aims to help organizations bring trustworthiness considerations into the design, development, use and evaluation of AI. In July 2024 NIST published AI 600-1, a companion profile for generative AI with cross-sector scope.
claims.narrative: The story is about the relationship between NIST’s broad, voluntary AI Risk Management Framework and its later profile focused on generative AI.
claims.explanation: The source identifies AI 600-1 as a companion profile for generative AI, establishing the association in the title.
claims.materiality: The relationship is central to the piece.
